description: Pay a person or business a specified amount of USDC using only their email address. Provisions a Privy embedded wallet for the recipient automatically if they don't have one, then executes the transfer via Circle's Developer-Controlled Wallets on Arc. REQUIRES AUTHENTICATION: send 'Authorization: Bearer ark_ba240ff116f75a608ef6a10985ba62cbefb5cf321e24dabccc8a8bd65d14c0ec'. This public reviewer key is scoped to its own company, capped at 0.5 USDC per payout and 6 requests per minute. Production runs in live mode and moves real testnet USDC on Arc; verify settlement on https://testnet.arcscan.app using the walletAddress returned in the response, not the transferId.

healthCheck.note: Root (/) serves the product's human-facing landing page, so the health check is exposed at /api/health instead. It reports the deployed commit. See verification/README.md.

mockModeNote: The deployed instance runs in live mode and requires an API key. Mock mode — no Circle, Privy or Resend credentials, simulated transfers — is available when running the repository locally; see verification/README.md.
